title: Align chat file preflight with the workspace write capability
goal: Reject non-workspace roots during chat preflight so accepted paths match the only root the built-in workspace file writer can execute.
context: The prior preflight accepted agents, skills, modules, tools, and workspace roots, but the production create-file Skill is bound to tool.workspace.write and its verification contract only accepts workspace-relative paths. Preflight should clarify invalid roots before provider or Skill routing.
forbidden_changes: Do not broaden the workspace write allowlist or add write capability to other roots.
Do not weaken policy, approval, protected-path, size-limit, or read-back verification.
Do not modify release workflows or Alpha/Stable release configuration.
Do not claim physical-device verification without testing on a real iPhone.
acceptance_criteria: Preflight only accepts workspace-relative create-file paths.
Requests targeting agents/ and tools/ roots deterministically ask for a valid workspace path.
Existing valid workspace paths and incomplete-request clarifications remain unchanged.
Regression tests cover unsupported roots and path traversal.
All changes stay within allowed_paths and required CI checks pass.
verification: Inspect Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA workflow results.
Physical iPhone acceptance remains tracked separately under Issue #347.
recovery: If tests or contract validation fail, correct the implementation or scope; never broaden runtime write permissions to make preflight pass.
